summary: Checked each claim against code and ran the two new tests. test/pr-status-decide.test.sh printed 20/20 and test/pr-status.test.sh printed 11/11. Both match the denominators in the mutation table (decide /20, pr-status /11). Confirmed in the diff: add-before-remove ordering (script, docs, and the "add before remove" test). Only newest-updated writer plan comments count. Permission comes from the collaborators API, and non-GitHub-shaped logins are never looked up (test 10). The 256-char cap, strict marker shape, phase and status allow-lists are in pr-status-decide.sh. The caller `if:` precedence is correct (`a || b && c`). The only checkout is this repository at job.workflow_sha, and values reach the scripts through env. templates/pr-status.yml cites docs/on-demand-ci.md "Pinning", which exists (line 231). The PR body has no base-relative facts. I did not re-run the mutation arms. The "every existing test passes" claim is outside what I reran. The gate-published phase movement in docs/pr-status.md, and the claim that GITHUB_TOKEN events start no workflow, rest on external behaviour I did not check.
